name: auth-clerk
title: Auth — Clerk
description: Sign in with Clerk for Lunora auth. Wires Clerk as an OIDC provider via better-auth's genericOAuth plugin, on top of the base `auth` item.
docs: Add `clerk` to your auth instance's `plugins` array in lunora/auth/index.ts: `import { clerk } from "./clerk.js"` then `plugins: [clerk(env)]`. Create the OAuth app in the Clerk dashboard, set the redirect/callback URL to `<BETTER_AUTH_URL>/api/auth/oauth2/callback/clerk`, and fill in CLERK_CLIENT_ID / CLERK_CLIENT_SECRET / CLERK_ISSUER_URL.

envVars.name: CLERK_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OAuth client ID from your Clerk application's OAuth credentials.

envVars.name: CLERK_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OAuth client secret from your Clerk application's OAuth credentials.

envVars.name: CLERK_ISSUER_URL
envVars.description: Clerk OIDC issuer, e.g. https://your-app.clerk.accounts.dev. The provider discovers endpoints from `<issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
